title: Detailed bathtub
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- floor shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="83" rx="38" ry="6" fill="#1a3a5c" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- bathtub outer body -->
  <path d="M10 55 Q10 78 20 80 L80 80 Q90 78 90 55 Z" fill="#f0f4f8" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- rim highlight -->
  <path d="M10 55 Q10 78 20 80 L80 80 Q90 78 90 55 Z" fill="none" stroke="#c8d8e8" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- bathtub rim -->
  <path d="M8 53 Q8 48 15 48 L85 48 Q92 48 92 53 Q92 57 85 57 L15 57 Q8 57 8 53 Z" fill="#dce8f4" stroke="none"/>
  <path d="M8 53 Q8 48 15 48 L85 48 Q92 48 92 53 Q92 57 85 57 L15 57 Q8 57 8 53 Z" fill="none" stroke="#b0c8dc" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- water surface -->
  <rect x="18" y="51" width="64" height="6" rx="3" fill="#4fc3f7"/>
  <!-- water sparkle -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="53" rx="6" ry="1.5" fill="#90dbfb"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="54" rx="4" ry="1" fill="#90dbfb"/>

  <!-- bubbles on water -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="50" r="3" fill="#e8f8ff" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="49" r="4" fill="#e8f8ff" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="49" r="2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="75" cy="52" r="2.5" fill="#e8f8ff" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="53" r="2" fill="#e8f8ff" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- inner tub shadow -->
  <path d="M16 57 L84 57 Q86 62 80 66 L20 66 Q14 62 16 57 Z" fill="#c4d8e8" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- left foot -->
  <path d="M18 79 L16 86 Q16 90 20 90 L26 90 Q30 90 30 86 L28 79 Z" fill="#e0e8f0"/>
  <path d="M18 79 L16 86 Q16 90 20 90 L26 90 Q30 90 30 86 L28 79 Z" fill="none" stroke="#b8ccd8" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- right foot -->
  <path d="M72 79 L70 86 Q70 90 74 90 L80 90 Q84 90 84 86 L82 79 Z" fill="#e0e8f0"/>
  <path d="M72 79 L70 86 Q70 90 74 90 L80 90 Q84 90 84 86 L82 79 Z" fill="none" stroke="#b8ccd8" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- faucet -->
  <rect x="44" y="36" width="12" height="12" rx="3" fill="#d0dce8"/>
  <rect x="44" y="36" width="12" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#a0b8cc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="47" y="30" width="6" height="8" rx="2" fill="#c0cedd"/>
  <rect x="47" y="30" width="6" height="8" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#a0b8cc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- spout -->
  <path d="M50 42 Q50 46 50 48" stroke="#b0c4d6" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- hot knob -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="42" r="7" fill="#ff6b6b"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="42" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#d94f4f" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="32.5" y="36.5" width="3" height="11" rx="1.5" fill="#ffaaaa"/>
  <rect x="32.5" y="36.5" width="3" height="11" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="#e08080" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <!-- Hot marking -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="42" r="2" fill="#ffcccc"/>

  <!-- cold knob -->
  <circle cx="66" cy="42" r="7" fill="#6bc5ff"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="42" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#4fa0d9" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="64.5" y="36.5" width="3" height="11" rx="1.5" fill="#aaddff"/>
  <rect x="64.5" y="36.5" width="3" height="11" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="#80c0e0" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <!-- Cold marking -->
  <circle cx="66" cy="42" r="2" fill="#cceeff"/>

  <!-- water dripping from spout -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#4fc3f7" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- rubber duck -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="49" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#ffd93d"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="49" rx="7" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#e0b820" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="43" r="4.5" fill="#ffd93d"/>
  <circle cx="33" cy="43" r="4.5" fill="none" stroke="#e0b820" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- duck beak -->
  <path d="M28.5 43 L26 44 L28.5 45 Z" fill="#ff8c42"/>
  <path d="M28.5 43 L26 44 L28.5 45 Z" fill="none" stroke="#d97030" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <!-- duck eye -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="42" r="1.2" fill="#2a4a6a"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="42" r="0.5" fill="#6a9abc"/>

  <!-- tub rim front highlight -->
  <path d="M12 56 Q50 60 88 56" stroke="#e8f0f8" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>

  <!-- drain -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="3" fill="#8aa8c0"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#6a88a0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="48.5" y1="72" x2="51.5" y2="72" stroke="#6a88a0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="70.5" x2="50" y2="73.5" stroke="#6a88a0" stroke-width="0.8"/>

  <!-- steam wisps -->
  <path d="M36 30 Q34 26 36 22" stroke="#a0d8f8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M56 28 Q58 24 56 20" stroke="#a0d8f8" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity="0.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44 26 Q42 22 44 18" stroke="#a0d8f8" stroke-width="1" fill="none" opacity="0.45" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
